name: Roasted Kabocha Squash (Japanese Pumpkin Flesh Only)
whyItWorks: Rich, chestnut-like Japanese pumpkin roasted until fluffy and tender. Dense in beta-carotene and soluble pectin; discard the tough dark green outer skin.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove seeds, cut into wedges, roast at 380°F until soft. Peel or fork away the thick dark green rind, eating only the sweet orange flesh.
